title: Loose Tablet & Strip Cutting: Fractional Billing

intro.title: Loose Tablet & Strip Cutting
intro.subtitle: Fractional strip sales, pro-rata pricing, and unit-level inventory tracking

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 3: Loose Tablet & Strip Cutting. In Indian retail pharmacies, patients frequently ask for fractional strips—such as five loose tablets instead of purchasing a full strip.
When you search and add a strip-based medicine like Paracetamol 650 to the cart, MediFlow automatically detects its units per pack—here, fifteen tablets per strip.

Notice the dual quantity columns: Packs and Loose. If the patient only needs five tablets, set Packs to zero and enter five in the Loose field. MediFlow instantly calculates the exact pro-rata rate of ten rupees without any manual math.
You can also combine full packs and loose tablets—for instance, one strip plus five loose tablets. The inventory tracker deducts twenty loose units accurately, preventing shelf stock discrepancies.
Fractional strip cutting makes healthcare affordable for patients while keeping your batch stock perfectly balanced. In Part 4, learn Fast Customer Selection and Three-Second Quick Add.

outro.takeaway: Fractional Billing: Sell exact loose tablets with automated pro-rata pricing and unit-level stock deduction.
